_embedThresholdScales: Game Design 23b item 3: a surface changes how deep a bowl looks, not how often he is held down. World's embed threshold (contact.json embed.minDepthBh) is times the surface's crater depth factor, so a slam embeds on every surface at today's rate. MARSH SWALLOW is the one deliberate embed (launch.biome.json). The down state stays 60 ticks everywhere

qa._ruled: QA's row, 23b item 3: embeds a minute, both fighters together

_switches: enabled: off, nothing here is read. touchBuilt: the rows for today's five classes (paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) in landing and craters are read only when this is true, so a world without the new biomes plays as today with the file on
_about: PARKED (Combat, 2026-10-23; docs/combat/biomes.md section 4). Choreography atoms that read the ground, keyed by World's surface class: the skid-stop a body makes when it is carried along the ground, how a recoil exit's landing changes, the approach's first steps, and the slam crater's shape. The rule over all of it (Orb's press feel, melee-press-feel.md): the ground changes distances, looks and the world, never when a press the brawl would take is taken. Two things the ground decides already hold control today, and Game Design ruled both (rulings-2026-10-23b.md): a carried body's journey, where ice returns control at rock's stop and the rest is a skate (item 2); and an embed, which keeps today's rate on every surface (item 3). Mud's 6-tick wait on movement is accepted (item 4). A recoil exit's landing slide comes after control has returned: momentum he can act out of. Its numbers that change the sim (crater factors, refill, embedMul, sunkMoveTicks, slideBh, tripAbove, controlAtBrake) need the replay's hash: in this file, or moved into World's hashed data. surfaces: the look classes, five that World has (contact.json: paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) and nine new, each with the class it reads as until World's profiles name it. World's ground profiles (data/biomes/ground.json, window 2) are the source of grip, absorb, rough and furrow, and each names its biome's look class ('look', World's window 3 or 4; accepted by the EP 2026-10-23); until a profile names one, its biome reads its profile's surface, so only the built looks show. World owns the craters; Animation the poses; VFX the trails and ejecta; Encounter picks the atoms and sends the events.

stripLooks._about: the look class an aftermath strip reads as, over its biome's (sigvariants.json aftermath kinds): glaze reads ice, ember crust, scree rubble, and a flood water

skidStop._about: how a body carried along the ground comes to rest: the upright slide of a short knock-back, the skid of a long one (World's slide on the feet), a guard's push-back. pose: Animation's stop (a shared pose with each fighter's flavour); trail: VFX's mark along the path; end: how he is left at rest; spin: true turns him through the slide so he ends square to the one who sent him. Distances are World's (the brake); nothing here holds a press

ice._skate: Game Design 23b item 2: control returns where the same send would have stopped at controlAtBrake (rock's 0.8), whatever grip World's profile gives the ice; the rest of the slide is a skate he can act out of

mud._sunk: movement waits 6 ticks while he pulls his feet out; presses are taken as ever. Accepted (23b item 4): only at the end of a skid in mud, never on walking in it

litter._trip: above this speed (units a second, unboosted) a root catches a foot: a stumble into a roll, ending on a knee. A look inside the stop's own distance and time, never a tumble

water._note: World's water rules decide skim or sink; this is the look of the stop

landing._about: how a recoil exit's landing (data/anim/recoil.json kinds: skip, handspring, tuck, backflip) changes by surface. slideBh: he lands into a slide this long (momentum after control returns); sinkBh: his feet sink this far (a look); burst: VFX's puff at the touch-down. Missing classes land as today

water._note: a landing on water is World's: skim or sink

approach._about: the first steps of a dash or a zip from the ground: a look, not a speed. Missing classes start as today

craters._about: the slam crater's shape by surface, for World's crater (sim/world/crater.gd dig, contact.json embed). Every factor multiplies today's bowl: radius, depth, rim (the berm), steep (the wall's slope). refill: the share of the depth that fills back, over refillTicks (sand and ash slump, mud closes, snow drifts). embedMul: times the depth a slammed body embeds (contact.json embed). cracks: Rendering's decal; ejecta: VFX's. fill: water that stands in the bowl. Missing classes dig today's bowl. embedMul is how deep an embedded body sits, not how often he embeds: the threshold scales with depth (embedThresholdScales), so the rate is today's on every surface (23b item 3)

ice._breakThrough: on sea ice, a bowl deeper than the floe breaks it into plates and opens water under him (World's floes)

litter._treesLean: trees within this many crater radii lean outward (World's props)

events._about: what Encounter sends so Animation, VFX, Camera and Audio can read the ground. Both ride today's events where one exists

skid_stop.sentAt: when the carried body starts its stop; rides World's slide event when it is a skid

ground_land.sentAt: a recoil exit's touch-down; rides the recoil cue's land tick

crater_shape.sentAt: World's crater event gains the surface and the shape it dug
